alt: David leaning on a stone railing above the terracotta rooftops of Florence, with the Palazzo Vecchio tower behind him
title: Above the rooftops
caption: From the top of the Duomo, the terracotta roofs run all the way to the hills, and the Palazzo Vecchio tower is the one thing taller than them.

alt: David in an I love pasta apron, sealing ravioli by hand at a wooden table in a rustic kitchen
title: Ravioli by hand
caption: My first job was at an Italian trattoria in Palm Beach Gardens. Years later I finally learned to make the pasta myself: fill, fold, press, repeat.

alt: David walking away from the camera down a narrow stone street lined with old buildings
title: On foot
caption: The best way to see an old city is to pick a stone street and keep walking until it runs out.

alt: David smiling at a sunny marina in Lisbon, with the red 25 de Abril bridge spanning the river behind him
title: Good vibes
caption: A bright afternoon at the marina on the Tagus, with the 25 de Abril bridge stretched across the river behind me.

alt: David standing by the ocean in warm evening light as the sun goes down
title: Golden hour
caption: Wherever the trip goes, the best evenings end the same way: somewhere by the water as the sun goes down.
